# Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning Accessibility Policy

Official source: https://mep.gov.sa/en/accessibilitypolicy

Source type: agency policy. Original official text must be captured and source-checked before transcribing in full. This Markdown is a paraphrased source record, not the original legal text.

## Reported topics

Fourteen-clause agency policy addresses WCAG 2.1, scope, monitoring, assistive technologies, forms, and periodic review. Multiple qualifiers mean a Boolean compliance determination is not supported without interpretation.
